subpages.title: MICROSENS - Industrial 10G Switches
subpages.desc: With the Profi Line 10G Ruggedized Switch MICROSENS heralds the 10G era in the field of industrial switches. With its 28 ports (4x 10GBase-X SFP+ slots, 24x 10/100/1000Base-T PoE+ ports according to IEEE 802.3at) this switch is suitable for cabling larger units in industrial environments as well as for in-house use.
